rv.q: "ADRIFT" is a masterclass in world-building with nothing but words, gestures, a few drums, and raw imagination.
Happenstance conjures an atmosphere through sensory touchstones that rivals any of the far more elaborate sets recently on local stages.

cn.t: Critics enthusiastically praise this whimsical medieval comedy, celebrating Happenstance Theater's inventive physical comedy and playful absurdist touches that capture humanity's timeless follies with charm and wit.
